I personally don't use TikTok, but from various second-hand reports, this platform seems to have become a hub for a lot of bad advice. Recently, there have even been tutorial videos telling people to put their iPhones in the freezer when they overheat...

Engadget cited one such example.

Obviously, you absolutely should not do this. The likely consequence is moisture condensing on the phone's internal components, which can happen either while it's in the freezer or after you take it out. Thermal shock is another risk, especially since lithium batteries are particularly sensitive to it.

The UK has been experiencing a heatwave over the past few weeks (by UK standards), and phone repair shops have reportedly seen a noticeable increase in cases of damaged phones caused by people following this advice.

If your iPhone overheats, Apple's official recommendation is to place it in a shaded area and let it cool naturally. But never leave it in a car. Even in hot weather, the temperature inside a car's glove compartment can be high enough to cause damage, or even cause the battery to catch fire.
